category: Agent document runtime — flow documents only (not OCR suites, not office GUIs)
north_star: A stranger opening github.com/kevin9327/docagent must immediately see an agent runtime as dense as MinerU/Docling: 200px hero, badges, one-line runtime strip, collapsed unique-yes details (C/Q/E · capsule SHA-256 ×3 · prove — none of the locked ten), harbor-mark convert trio (teal under H2) and capsule SHA-256 ×3 lockstep with letter-capsule.json ABOVE the vs-the-ten matrix; Command::Convert Quickstart sits BELOW that matrix (MinerU features-before-install). Picture in, PDF/A out. PNG/JPEG in Markdown/HTML/DOCX/ODT become a PDF/A XObject. GPU-free. Not OCR. DocAgent wins Command/Query/Event, capsule hashes, integer layout, byte-identical reruns. Hangul is a regional codec, not the first-screen story. Demo-image gap is closed. Do not claim the WeasyPrint print-CSS tightness gap is closed.
